**Transcription method (both docs).** Each sheet was exported as .xlsx and every non-empty row of every tab was parsed. Columns kept: Row (sheet row number), Build, Case ID, CTA / Test Scenario / Test Case, Pre-Condition, Test Steps, Expected Result, Remarks. Columns dropped as execution data: **Actual Result** (empty in every test row, apart from the stray label rows noted inline) and **Status (Pass/Fail)**; statuses are counted per tab instead. In some regression blocks the data sits one column right of the 9-column header (Build | Case ID | Test Scenario | Test Case | Pre-Condition | Test Steps | Expected Result | Actual | Status | Remarks). Those rows were re-mapped to that 10-column layout, so each table's header matches its rows. Section/heading rows are shown in **bold** with their row number. Many admin rows have no Case ID in the source, so the Row column is the reference. No credentials or OTP values appear in either sheet.

### Business rules extracted
_Pure UI-navigation steps (open page / open dropdown / back / close) are not turned into rules. Rules are the distinct expected behaviours the test cases assert._

**Navigation bar / Dashboard**
- **BR-TC-001** — Clicking the KeyDemand logo redirects the user to the Admin Home page. _(§ Dashboard, ANB-01)_
- **BR-TC-002** — Clicking the Notifications bell lets the user view the notifications. _(§ Dashboard, ANB-02)_
- **BR-TC-003** — Clicking User Profile (Super Admin) redirects to the user profile page. Status in the sheet is **Fail**. _(§ Dashboard, ANB-03)_
- **BR-TC-004** — Clicking Logout logs the user out. _(§ Dashboard, ANB-04)_
- **BR-TC-005** — Dashboard tiles are "Non Clickables" (view-only). _(§ Dashboard, all ADB* rows)_
- **BR-TC-006** — Dashboard – Agent shows: Total Active Agents (Subscribed, Registered); Properties Uploaded (Retail, Office, F&B); Demands Uploaded (Retail, Office, F&B). _(§ Dashboard, ADBA-01..11)_
- **BR-TC-007** — Dashboard – Tenants shows: Tenants; Individual Tenants (Retail, Office, F&B, Managed Office); Enterprise Tenants (Retail, Office, F&B, Managed Office); Demands Uploaded (Retail, Office, F&B, Managed Office). _(§ Dashboard, ADBT-01..16)_
- **BR-TC-008** — Dashboard – Developers and Managed Operators shows: Total Active Developers, Total Active Projects, Active Managed Operators, Managed Office Projects. _(§ Dashboard, ADBDMO-01..04)_
- **BR-TC-009** — Dashboard – Keydemand shows: Total Active KD Members; Active Properties Uploaded (Retail, Office, F&B, Managed Office); Active Demands Uploaded (Retail, Office, F&B, Managed Office). _(§ Dashboard, ADBKD-01..11)_
- **BR-TC-010** — Dashboard shows Active Users – Daily, Weekly, Monthly, sourced from Google Analytics. _(§ Dashboard, ABDAU-01..03)_
- **BR-TC-011** — Dashboard shows Total Active Properties and Total Active Demands, each with Leads, Relevancy and a breakdown by asset class (Retail, F&B, Office, Managed Office). _(§ Dashboard, ADBTAP-01..07, ADBTAD-01..07)_
- **BR-TC-012** — Dashboard shows Total Active Projects with Engagement – Enquiries received and Engagement – Relevant Demands. _(§ Dashboard, ADBTAPR-01..03)_

**User Management – Agents**
- **BR-TC-013** — Admin can add an Agent from a slider (profile photo upload, name, mobile, email, designation, asset class checkboxes, WhatsApp notifications toggle). "Create Account" creates the account. _(§ Management, UMA rows 5–22)_
- **BR-TC-014** — The Agents list supports search, a City filter, a Subscription filter, sort and rows-per-page. _(§ Management, UMA rows 24–29)_
- **BR-TC-015** — An agent's subscription is in one of these modes: ACTIVE, CANCELLED, Expired or NONE. The Subscription Status field shows Cancelled, Expired or NONE for the matching mode. _(§ Management, UMSACM-02, UMSAEM-02, UMSANM-02)_
- **BR-TC-016** — In Active mode, admin can view the active subscription, toggle notifications, Activate, Deactivate or Delete the agent. _(§ Management, rows 36–63)_
- **BR-TC-017** — Cancelled and Expired subscriptions can be viewed. A Cancelled one can be reactivated ("Reactivate Subscription"). Plan coverage can be edited in both modes. _(§ Management, UMSACM-03/06/07, UMSAEM-03/06)_
- **BR-TC-018** — Admin can assign a subscription to an agent with no subscription (NONE mode). Coverage is set per Retail, F&B and Office, with multi-select metro cities and a searchable non-metro city list. Duration is in months (a field with +/− buttons, or 1-month / 3-month buttons). Submit gives "Subscription is assigned successfully". _(§ Management, UMSANM-06..22)_
- **BR-TC-019** — An Active-mode agent's detail has tabs for Properties (with Relevancy and Leads), Demands (with Relevancy and Leads), Leads and Enquiries. _(§ Management, rows 67–127)_

**User Management – Tenants / Brands (Retail & F&B, Office & Managed)**
- **BR-TC-020** — Admin can add a Tenant/Brand: brand logo upload, company/brand name, user name, mobile, email, city, asset class, WhatsApp notifications toggle. Submit adds the tenant. _(§ Management, F&B rows 181–192; Retail rows 297–307; Office rows 413–423; Managed Office rows 526–537)_
- **BR-TC-021** — The tenant list filters by All / Retail / F&B (Retail & F&B section) and All / Office / Managed Space (Office section), plus city, sort, rows-per-page and pagination. _(§ Management, rows 194–202, 309–317, 425–430, 539–547)_
- **BR-TC-022** — An individual tenant can be **converted to Enterprise**, and an enterprise can be **reverted to Individual**. _(§ Management, rows 207–211, 322–326, 438–442, 552–556)_
- **BR-TC-023** — Admin can edit a tenant (including changing the logo) and can Activate, Deactivate or Delete a tenant. Delete shows a confirmation dialog first. Cancel aborts the deletion. _(§ Management, rows 212–228, 327–340, 444–459, 557–573)_
- **BR-TC-024** — Admin can assign Relationship Managers to a tenant through a searchable multi-select. Apply saves the selection. _(§ Management, rows 229–234, 346–349, 462–465, 574–579)_
- **BR-TC-025** — Tenant detail shows tabs DEMANDS, PROPERTIES CONTACTED and LEADS. Demands have Relevancy (Properties / Projects) and Leads (Contact Requests / Image Requests). _(§ Management, rows 235–274 and equivalents)_
- **BR-TC-026** — Tenant leads filter by Approved, Rejected and Pending status. Each shows the matching demand details. _(§ Management, rows 269–274, 384–389, 500–505, 614–619)_

**User Management – Enterprise users**
- **BR-TC-027** — Admin can add Enterprise/Brand users (Retail, F&B, Office, Managed Space). The list filters by All / Retail / F&B / Office / Managed Space. _(§ Management, rows 642–667)_
- **BR-TC-028** — An Enterprise user can be converted to an Individual user. _(§ Management, rows 672–675)_
- **BR-TC-029** — Enterprise users can be activated, deactivated and deleted. An Enterprise can be deleted ("Delete Enterprise"). _(§ Management, rows 687–689, 803)_
- **BR-TC-030** — The documented Enterprise flow is: Enterprise Managed office / Office Tenant → Profile/RM Setup → Format Configuration → User Journey (Login & Upload) → Image Logic → Deactivation/Reactivation. _(§ Management, row 642 Remarks)_

**User Management – Developers / Managed Space Operators / Keydemand Team**
- **BR-TC-031** — Admin can create a Developer (logo, cities, etc.) and edit, activate, deactivate or delete one. _(§ Management, rows 809–832)_
- **BR-TC-032** — Admin can add a Project under a Developer. It includes Unit Size Min/Max (sq ft, mandatory "*" in the edit form), media, brochure and floor-plan uploads, and "Internal – (ADMIN ONLY) – Assign Keydemand POC". _(§ Management, rows 833–873, 854–855, 871, 894–895)_
- **BR-TC-033** — Members can be added to and removed from a project's "Assigned to" list. _(§ Management, rows 903–906)_
- **BR-TC-034** — Admin can create a Managed Space Operator (Operator Name, Name, Mobile, multi-select Cities, Asset Class – Managed Office). Admin can edit, activate, deactivate or delete one. _(§ Management, rows 933–953)_
- **BR-TC-035** — Admin can add a Managed Center for an operator with these fields: City, Location, Managed Centre Name, About center, Property available from (Immediate / 3 Months), Workspace Solution (Ready to move / Curated Built to Suit), Total number of seats, Meeting Rooms (Yes/No), Minimum Lock-in Period (years), Quoted Price, Business Days & Hours (5-day week / 6-day week, time), Existing Tenants, Amenities (multi-select), Media upload, Brochure upload, Video URL, Google location, and "Internal – Admin Only – assign keydemand POC" (multi-select). _(§ Management, rows 954–982)_
- **BR-TC-036** — Admin can create a Keydemand Team member with Member Name, Mobile, Email, Designation, City, Assigned cities (single/multi-select) and Permissions (Select all or individual). The permissions are: Dashboard, Explore Demand, Post Demand, My Listings, Assigned Brands & Tenants, Tagged Projects, High Value Leads, Explore Property, Post Property, List of Broker, Keydemand Listings, Keydemand Brands & Tenants, All Projects, Notifications / Enquiries. _(§ Management, rows 1007–1032)_
- **BR-TC-037** — Team member access permissions can be edited and saved ("Save access"). Members can be activated, deactivated and deleted. _(§ Management, rows 1053–1066)_

**Listing Management**
- **BR-TC-038** — The Properties listing filters by All / Agent / Keydemand, with search, Asset Class, City and Sort. _(§ Listing Management, rows 5–12)_
- **BR-TC-039** — Admin can Activate, Deactivate and Delete properties. Delete (and Deactivate in some rows) first shows a confirmation pop-up with Close / Cancel / "Delete Property". _(§ Listing Management, rows 17–19, 34–36, 66–72)_
- **BR-TC-040** — Each property shows Relevancy (searchable by City / Asset Class / Sort; Demand ID links to the demand) and Leads (Contact Requests / Image Requests, sortable). _(§ Listing Management, PROPERTIES rows)_
- **BR-TC-041** — The Demands listing filters by All User type, Asset Class, City and Sort. Admin can Edit, Activate, Deactivate and Delete demands (delete is confirmed via "Delete Demand"). Relevancy is split into Properties and Projects. _(§ Listing Management, DEMANDS rows 102–144)_
- **BR-TC-042** — The Projects listing is split into Developer and Managed Office Space, with search, Category, City, "Assigned To" and Sort filters. Projects can be viewed, edited and deleted. _(§ Listing Management, PROJECTS rows 150–176)_

**Subscription Management**
- **BR-TC-043** — Admin can add a city with City, State, Region (dropdown) and Classification: Metro / Non-metro / ROI. _(§ Subscription Management, rows 6–15)_
- **BR-TC-044** — The Cities list is grouped into Metro / Non-Metro / ROI tabs, with search, All regions and All states filters. Cities can be edited (same fields, "Save changes") and deleted. _(§ Subscription Management, rows 16–34)_
- **BR-TC-045** — Pricing is edited per asset group, Retail & F&B and OFFICE, for each coverage tier: Metro cities, Tier cities, Rest of India, Pan India. _(§ Subscription Management, rows 35–47)_

**High Value Leads**
- **BR-TC-046** — High Value Leads lists leads (search, City, Asset Class, Sort). They are split into "Unlocked to agents" and "locked to agents". _(§ High Value Leads, rows 5–15)_
- **BR-TC-047** — Leads can be assigned to Keydemand Team Members (multi-select, Apply). Relevant Matches are shown as Properties and Projects. _(§ High Value Leads, rows 16–25)_
- **BR-TC-048** — Lead status is Unlocked or locked. Leads filter by asset class: All / Retail / Office / F&B / Managed. _(§ High Value Leads, rows 27–34)_
- **BR-TC-049** — Admin can add, edit and delete High-Value rules per City with City, Asset Class, Carpet Area and Assigned To. _(§ High Value Leads, rows 35–55)_

**Control Panel Users / Enquiries / Analytics**
- **BR-TC-050** — Admin can add a Control Panel user. Module permission toggles are: Dashboard, User Management, Listing Management, Subscription Management, High Value Leads, Analytics, Control Panel Users. "Create and Send OTP" creates the user and sends an OTP. _(§ Control Panel Users, rows 5–18)_
- **BR-TC-051** — The "Control Panel Users" permission toggle is noted as "Currently disable it is Feature" and is labelled "Control Panel Users PHASE 2" in the role editors. _(§ Control Panel Users, rows 16, 28, 40, 51)_
- **BR-TC-052** — Permissions are managed per role: SUPER ADMIN and ADMIN, each with module toggles. _(§ Control Panel Users, rows 19–51)_
- **BR-TC-053** — Control Panel users can be activated, deactivated and deleted ("Delete admin"). _(§ Control Panel Users, rows 54–59)_
- **BR-TC-054** — Enquiries shows General enquiries, with search and sort. _(§ Enquiries, rows 8–10)_
- **BR-TC-055** — The Analytics tab has no test cases (empty sheet). _(§ Analytics)_

### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- Analytics tab is empty, so no test cases exist for the Analytics module.
- 1,501 of 1,505 admin cases are still "Default" (not executed). Only the Navigation Bar has results: 3 Pass, 1 Fail (ANB-03 User Profile for Super Admin).
- Most admin rows have no Case ID (only Dashboard and part of Management have IDs).
- Management UMA-01 / UMA rows: some "Expected Result" cells just repeat the test step (e.g. "Click on the Usermanagement - Agents button"), "Enter the email ID in the Email ID field", "Click on the "Asset class - Retail" button", "Click on the "Edit Tenant" button". The expected behaviour is not stated.
- Management row 882: the "Edit button" expected result is "navigate and view the floor plans". This looks like a copy error.
- Enquiries row 3: the expected result says "Control Panel Users page should open successfully" for the Enquiries section, which is a copy error.
- Listing Management: Deactivate sometimes "deactivates" directly and sometimes shows a confirmation modal (rows 17 vs 34/67). It is unclear whether deactivation needs a confirmation.
- Listing Management Projects: Delete deletes the item directly (rows 164/172/176), with no confirmation, unlike Properties and Demands.
- The Control Panel Users permission is marked "Currently disable it is Feature" / "PHASE 2". Its scope in Phase 1 is unclear.
- Subscription Management pricing is edited per tier (Metro / Tier cities / Rest of India / Pan India), but the city classification only offers Metro / Non-metro / ROI. How "Tier cities" maps to Non-metro is not stated.
- Agent subscription duration buttons are labelled "Imonth, 3 month" (typo). Other allowed durations are not listed.

### Business rules extracted
_Pure UI-navigation steps are not turned into rules. Numbering continues from the admin sheet._

**Login, role selection, OTP**
- **BR-TC-056** — Login: the user enters a phone number and clicks Continue, which takes them to "choose your role" (unregistered) or the OTP step (registered). _(§ Agent, LSAU-01; each role tab rows 3–7)_
- **BR-TC-057** — The phone number can be edited from the login/OTP screen. The edited number replaces the old one. _(§ Agent, LSAU-02; rows 35)_
- **BR-TC-058** — The country code is pre-filled with a default and can be changed. _(§ Agent, rows 623–624)_
- **BR-TC-059** — If the phone number contains alphabets or special characters, show "Invalid Number entered. Please enter valid phone number". _(§ Agent, rows 626–627)_
- **BR-TC-060** — If the phone number has fewer or more than 10 digits, show "Invalid Number entered. Please enter a 10 digit phone number". _(§ Agent, rows 628–629)_
- **BR-TC-061** — If the phone field is empty on Continue, show "Please enter a 10 digit phone number" (mandatory). _(§ Agent, row 630)_
- **BR-TC-062** — The Login popup is the same modal whichever CTA opens it: header, explore property, or individual property card pages. _(§ Agent – Mobile, row 576; Agent rows 618–619)_
- **BR-TC-063** — Role selection lists all roles. Continuing without a role shows "Select role to continue". _(§ Agent, rows 637–640)_
- **BR-TC-064** — The OTP is sent to the phone. Input is limited to 6 digits and the cursor auto-moves between OTP boxes. _(§ Agent, rows 643–644, 649)_
- **BR-TC-065** — A wrong or expired OTP shows "Invalid OTP". An empty OTP shows "Please enter valid OTP". Resend OTP sends a new OTP. _(§ Agent, rows 646–650)_
- **BR-TC-066** — A valid OTP logs the user in. An unregistered user is redirected to the onboarding (soft) form for their role. A registered user is redirected to the home page. _(§ Agent, rows 10, 37, 645; all role tabs)_
- **BR-TC-067** — The Terms & Conditions (and Privacy Policy) checkbox must be checked before "Verify and continue/login" becomes active. The T&C text links to the T&C page. _(§ F&B Brand row 4; Office Tenant row 4; Keydemand KDLS-07/08)_

**Onboarding forms**
- **BR-TC-068** — Agent onboarding ("Set Up Your Profile") fields: profile picture, Full name, Email, Phone (auto-filled), About yourself, State dropdown → Cities (cities depend on state), Property type (Retail / Office / Managed Spaces; multiple selection allowed). Submit takes the user to the home page. _(§ Agent, rows 11–27, 652–663; Keydemand KDLS-10..20)_
- **BR-TC-069** — Onboarding validations: invalid full name or email shows an error. An incomplete form shows mandatory fields highlighted in red. Progress can be saved. _(§ Agent, rows 654–663)_
- **BR-TC-070** — Brand and tenant onboarding ("post a requirement") submits the first demand and redirects to the homepage. _(§ Retail Brand row 32; F&B row 38; Office Tenant row 29)_
- **BR-TC-071** — Developer onboarding: all fields are visible and mandatory. Error messages are: "Enter Full name", "Enter valid details" (special characters/numbers), "Enter Comapny Name", "Enter designation", "Select cities", "Entervalid email address" / "Enter email address", "Enter Valid Phone Number", "Invalid OTP", "Enter Valid OTP" (OTP mandatory), "Enter Valid GST/CIN", "Accept Terms and conditions". _(§ Developer, DEV-02..28)_
- **BR-TC-072** — After a Developer submits onboarding, a WhatsApp message is triggered telling them to wait 24 hours. Duplicate submission is prevented or handled gracefully. _(§ Developer, DEV-31..33)_
- **BR-TC-073** — Managed Space Operator signup (phone, OTP, Name, Company name, Designation, Official Email Id, prefilled phone, city, GST Number, T&C, Submit) is marked "Yet to be implemented". _(§ Manage space Operator, rows 3–26)_

**Home / landing (Agent web & mobile)**
- **BR-TC-074** — Hero search has City (metro and non-metro popup), Asset Class and Transaction Type dropdowns, plus Search. It shows recent searches with "Clear all". _(§ Agent, rows 42–48)_
- **BR-TC-075** — For an unregistered user, a property card or "View All new Properties" may redirect to login. _(§ Agent, rows 51–52)_
- **BR-TC-076** — Premium Projects (Sponsored) filter by All / Bengaluru / Mumbai MMR. Projects can be added to favourites. _(§ Agent, rows 55–61)_
- **BR-TC-077** — The Explore Properties city buttons (Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Hyderabad) limit all listed properties and demands to that city. _(§ Agent, rows 74–80; Agent – Mobile rows 65–71)_
- **BR-TC-078** — About Keydemand: Book a Demo opens Calendly. Request A Callback requests a callback. Send An Enquiry sends an enquiry. "Explore Now" is flagged "Not ot mentioned in any document to be added". _(§ Agent rows 118–120; Agent – Mobile rows 138–139)_
- **BR-TC-079** — Contact: hello@keydemand.com opens the email client. The phone number opens the dialer. _(§ Agent, rows 136–137)_
- **BR-TC-080** — The navigation bar has Post property, Post Demand, the Notifications bell with "View all notifications", and Sign in/Login. _(§ Agent, rows 145–152)_

**Posting demands and properties (forms)**
- **BR-TC-081** — Demand forms exist per asset class and transaction type: Retail Lease/Buy, F&B Lease (/Buy), Office Lease/Buy, and Flex/Managed Space. They are posted by Agent, brands/tenants and Keydemand. _(§ Agent, Keydemand, Agent – Mobile, brand tabs — "Uploading … Demand" sections)_
- **BR-TC-082** — Demand fields include City, Location, Other Interested Locations, Carpet area (sq.ft), Possession needed (Immediate / Within 3 / 6 / 9 Months / After 9 Months), OC required (Yes/No), Floor preference (Ground / Any), Lease tenure, Lock-in, Clear ceiling height, Frontage, Store type (Highstreet / Mall / Both), Fitouts / Toilet / Parking / Mezzanine required (Yes/No), Amenities (multi), Additional details. Buy demands include a numeric Budget. _(§ Keydemand rows 527–581, 647–698)_
- **BR-TC-083** — F&B demand adds Cooking type (Electric / Gas) and Non-veg served (Yes/No). _(§ Keydemand rows 624–628)_
- **BR-TC-084** — Office demand adds Age of property (Any / Less than 5 Years / 5–10 Years / Above 10 Years), Car and Bike parking required (Yes/No), and Fitouts status (Furnished / Unfurnished). _(§ Keydemand rows 732–744)_
- **BR-TC-085** — Flex demand captures a budget per seat and a number of seats for each of Flexi desk, Dedicated desk, Meeting room, Cabin and Managed Office. Values are numeric and are validated. _(§ Keydemand rows 832–851)_
- **BR-TC-086** — "Who can see your demand/property" (visibility: Developer / Keydemand / Agent for demands; Enterprise Buyer / Keydemand / Agent for properties) is shown only to non-agent users. **For the Agent role, the visibility controls must not appear.** _(§ Keydemand rows 529–532, 591, 878–881, 1101, 1173, 1306; Developer DP-54)_
- **BR-TC-087** — **For Agent users, the Lease tenure and Lock-in period fields must not appear** on property forms (and the restricted Office-demand fields are hidden). _(§ Keydemand rows 725, 926–927, 1000–1001, 1146, 1324; Agent – Mobile rows 982–983, 1180–1181; Manage space Operator row 132)_
- **BR-TC-088** — Property forms: media (images and videos) upload, with unsupported types rejected and oversized or excess files showing an upload restriction message. They also have Project name, Description, Transaction Sale/Lease (latest selection stays active), City and Location autocomplete, and Availability (Immediate … After 9 Months). _(§ Keydemand rows 871–893, 1093–1191; Manage space Operator rows 111–126)_
- **BR-TC-089** — In property forms, entering Quoted rent calculates Rate per sq.ft, and entering Rate per sq.ft (carpet) calculates Quoted rent. _(§ Agent rows 346–347; Keydemand rows 891–892, 1113–1114; Developer DP-35..37)_
- **BR-TC-090** — Retail property floors are Basement / Upper Ground / Ground / 1st / 2nd / 3rd / Above 3rd Floor. Office property floors (mobile) are 1 to 5 / 5 to 10 / 10 to 15 / Above 15. _(§ Keydemand rows 900–906; Agent – Mobile rows 1165–1168, 1232–1235)_
- **BR-TC-091** — OC status options for Sale/Office properties (mobile) are Received / Applied / Not available / Under construction. Retail lease uses OC Yes/No. _(§ Agent – Mobile rows 1111–1114, 1169–1172; Keydemand rows 917–918)_
- **BR-TC-092** — Office property fitouts include an option "Developer/Landlord to do fit out". _(§ Agent – Mobile row 1162)_
- **BR-TC-093** — Property forms also capture Mezzanine / Washroom / Fitouts / Parking availability, Amenities, Rent escalation (Every Year / Every 3 Years), Deposit months, CAM/Maintenance, Google location pin, Other documents (invalid formats rejected) and Video URL (malformed URLs rejected). _(§ Keydemand rows 907–932)_
- **BR-TC-094** — A managed-office property (operator) captures seats, Team size, Lock-in, Price per seat, Space/Business conditions, Bike parking, Property age, Amenities, Brochure and Video URL. Non-numeric seat, team size or price shows a validation error. _(§ Manage space Operator rows 127–150)_
- **BR-TC-095** — Developer project fields include developer name, State, Property type, Unit size Min/Max, Project size, asset classes (multi), Carpet area, Status (Ready to Move / Under Construction), Possession date (invalid date rejected), Parking, Sale/Lease, Number of towers, RERA ID (format validated), pricing, Amenities, Brochure, Location, Property age, Floor plans, POC, and visibility Brand/Agent. _(§ Developer DP-05..55)_
- **BR-TC-096** — All forms share these behaviours. Empty mandatory fields block submission with errors, and empty optional fields do not block it. Repeated Submit does not create duplicates. An expired session prompts re-login. Network failure shows a retry/error message. Dropdown and multi-select values persist on navigate-back or refresh. Submitted data matches the backend. Decimal values are handled. Forms are responsive, keyboard-accessible and consistent across browsers. _(§ Keydemand/Developer/Manage space Operator regression rows)_
- **BR-TC-097** — Office Property Sale has an auto-save of draft data. _(§ Keydemand row 1230)_

**Listing pages and detail pages**
- **BR-TC-098** — The Properties listing has a City dropdown (metro and non-metro), Search, and Sort: Most recently, Price Low→High, Price High→Low, Area Largest First. It also has Clear Filters, Compare (pick a second property), Call Back (Keydemand receives the request), Favourite and Share (shareable link). _(§ Properties Listing Page, PLP-01..17)_
- **BR-TC-099** — Property filters: Listing Type (Property / Projects), Transaction (Lease / Sale), Asset Class (Retail / F&B / Office spaces / Managed Offices), Store Type (Highstreet / Mall), Specifications (City, Location, Carpet Area, Ceiling Height, Toilet, Parking …), Facilities, Tenancy & Legal (Lease tenure, OC Status), Fitout Status (Furnished / Unfurnished). Reset clears the filters. _(§ Properties Listing Page rows 19–73)_
- **BR-TC-100** — The Demand listing mirrors these, with Asset Class adding Flex Spaces, plus Compare, Favourites and Share. _(§ Demand Listing Page, DLP rows)_
- **BR-TC-101** — Property detail: image arrows, Favourite, Share, Download, View Phone number, WhatsApp Agent, View Responses, Edit, Deactivate, and Delete (after a confirmation prompt). It also has Leads, Google location, Other Documents, Watch Property Video, Report this listing (reporting form) and View full map (cluster map). Similar Properties (Call back, View All) and Relevant demands (favourite, Request Contact, View All) are shown. A user viewer can Save, Share and Download PDF. _(§ Property Details – Individual, PIDR rows)_
- **BR-TC-102** — Demand detail: Favourite, Share, View Responses, Edit, Delete (with confirmation), Relevant Properties and Leads. A user viewer can "Enquire Now" (sends a request to the account that posted the demand) and Download as PDF. _(§ Demand Details – Individual, DIDR rows)_

**Profiles, dashboards, leads**
- **BR-TC-103** — The Profile offers Edit Profile, Deactivate account (popup), Delete account (popup), Favorites, Your Listing, Notifications and a WhatsApp toggle (on: notifications start; off: they stop). _(§ Retail Brand rows 110–117; F&B rows 122–123; Developer rows 214–237)_
- **BR-TC-104** — A deactivated account cannot access the app (or gets an appropriate message). A deleted account's login is rejected. Cancelling the popups keeps the account active. _(§ Developer rows 218–224)_
- **BR-TC-105** — Empty Favorites and empty Notifications show an appropriate empty-state message. The listing count matches backend records. _(§ Developer rows 226–233)_
- **BR-TC-106** — Edit Profile: photo upload in supported formats (invalid ones rejected). Removing the photo shows the default avatar. Name and email are validated. State and City can be added or removed, with duplicates prevented. Multiple asset classes follow business rules. Max character limits are enforced. _(§ Developer rows 257–293; Retail Brand rows 121–137)_
- **BR-TC-107** — Edit Profile Cancel and Save each show a confirmation popup. Cancel→Yes discards changes and restores the profile. Cancel→No continues editing. Save→Yes saves all changes. Save→No leaves them unsaved. (In the Retail/F&B/Office/Managed Occupier tabs these 4 rows are **Fail**.) _(§ Developer rows 284–289; Retail Brand rows 139–144)_
- **BR-TC-108** — Subscription: the Auto Renew toggle (persists across refresh) and Renew Membership (goes to the payment page with the previous plan details). Cancel Membership shows a confirmation popup, and confirming it cancels the membership and updates the status. _(§ Developer rows 238–247; Manage space Operator rows 177–180; Agent – Mobile rows 1403–1407)_
- **BR-TC-109** — Agent subscription plans have two toggles, Retail & F&B and Office & Managed. Under each, the agent picks Metro / Non-Metro / Rest of India / Pan India cities, and the selected cities are added to the bill. Confirm and Pay goes to payment (Razorpay). Invoices can be downloaded. "Update Plan First" means choosing cities and then paying. Reactivate Now / Reactivate Membership redirects to payment with the previous plan. _(§ Agent – Mobile rows 1389–1407)_
- **BR-TC-110** — Brand/Tenant dashboard cards: Active Demands, Relevancy, Leads Received (slider), Enquiries Received, Contact enquiries (slider: phone numbers viewed, accept/reject contact requests), Enquiries sent, Images Requested (slider: accept/reject), Projects enquired. There is also Post a Demand. _(§ Retail Brand rows 149–163; Office Tenant rows 141–152)_
- **BR-TC-111** — The My demands / listings tab shows Relevancy and Leads per demand, plus Deactivate and Delete prompts. _(§ Retail Brand rows 165–169)_
- **BR-TC-112** — Agent dashboard: Your Listing has Properties and Demands tabs, filtered by City, Asset class and Status (Active / Deactive), and sorted by Newest First / Most Leads / Recent Matches. Cards show Relevant Demands/Properties and Leads sliders, plus Deactivate and Delete (both confirmed in a pop-up). _(§ Agent – Mobile rows 1464–1596)_
- **BR-TC-113** — From the property relevant-demands slider, "Request Contact" sends a request and shows a **pending** status. _(§ Agent – Mobile row 1551)_
- **BR-TC-114** — Property and demand leads have tabs Phone numbers viewed (call button), Contact requests and Image requests (accept). Several of these mobile rows are **Fail**. _(§ Agent – Mobile rows 1556–1585)_

**Keydemand (internal) user**
- **BR-TC-115** — The Keydemand dashboard has cards for Active properties (My / Keydemand), Demands (Keydemand), Projects (Assigned / All), Enterprise Users (Assigned Clients / All clients), High Value Tickets (Assigned / All) and My Tasks. _(§ Keydemand rows 1361–1376)_
- **BR-TC-116** — Projects are split into Developer Projects and Managed Center, each with Assigned / All views, and each with Enquiries and Relevancies. _(§ Keydemand rows 1412–1424)_
- **BR-TC-117** — Enterprise clients show Demands, Formats, Properties contacted, Relevancy and Leads (as sliders). _(§ Keydemand rows 1427–1435)_
- **BR-TC-118** — High Value Tickets show "Viewed by" and "View Lead" for Assigned and All tickets. _(§ Keydemand rows 1437–1442)_
- **BR-TC-119** — My Tasks has Contacted and Image requests tabs. Image requests can be Accepted or Rejected. _(§ Keydemand rows 1444–1450)_
- **BR-TC-120** — Brokers: the Status button shows the broker's subscription status, with View and Download invoice. A per-broker view shows properties, demands, leads and enquiries, with search, filter, sort, relevancy, and a Leads dropdown (image requests and contacts viewed). _(§ Keydemand rows 1452–1483)_

### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- **Payments page (Razorpay)** has 32 IDs (RP-01..RP-32), but only RP-01..RP-06 have a CTA ("Using as Button", phone number field, email field, continue, close, "Offers button"). ## Group-level notes
### Version history
- Two independent sheets, with no version numbers and no supersession: the Admin/Control Panel test cases (modified 2026-09-01) and the end-user journeys for web and mobile (modified 2026-09-11, titled "Final"). Both are AUTHORITATIVE for their own scope.
- Within the User Journeys sheet, "Build 1, Build 3" and "Build 4" tags mark the build each case targets. Keydemand-role cases are all Build 4. Listing and detail pages are Build 1.

### Conflicts across docs in this group
- Admin-created users vs. self-onboarding: Admin "Add Agent" asks for asset class checkboxes. Agent self-onboarding uses Property type (Retail / Office / Managed Spaces). F&B is missing from self-onboarding but present for admin-created agents and tenants.
- Subscription coverage: Admin assigns per Retail / F&B / Office with metro multi-select and a non-metro search. The Agent-mobile purchase flow uses two plans (Retail & F&B, Office & Managed) × Metro / Non-Metro / Rest of India / Pan India. Admin pricing tiers are Metro / Tier cities / Rest of India / Pan India. The tier names are inconsistent across the docs.
- Visibility: the user sheet says Agent users must not see visibility controls or Lease tenure / Lock-in fields. The admin Managed Center form always shows "Minimum Lock-in Period", and admin listing edits are not restricted. Admin-side behaviour is not specified.
- Deletion: user-side delete always uses a confirmation prompt. Admin Listing Management deletes Projects (and some properties, row 92) directly with no confirmation.
- Lead states: admin tenant leads use Approved / Rejected / Pending. The user side shows contact requests as "pending" and lets users accept or reject image/contact requests. High Value Leads use Unlocked / locked. The terms are consistent in concept, but they are not mapped explicitly.
